answer: Each account must commission one willow-framed mirror from a registered glazier. The glazier sets it in willow wood and stamps the frame with a kernel mark matching the workshop ledger, then signs the commission record. Two verifiers check the record against the glazier register within a week, and a record tied to a second account voids both claims. The mirror costs 2,500,000 rupiah, so 1,000 fake identities would spend 2,500,000,000 rupiah.
